spans.s:
CHUCK (v.):
I To check: q. v.
II To
strike gently: q. v.

CHUCK (subs.):
I v. Cluck.
II A slight
blow: चपेटिका (with the open hand)
ईषत्पप्रहारः।
III A term of endearment: जातः
(ता, तं).

CHUCKLE (v. i.): i. e. to laugh in a broken
manner: v. To laugh.

CHURCH (subs.):
I Any temple: q. v.
II.
A Christian temple: *सिद्धायतनम्
or
धर्ममन्दिरम्
(when the context determines the mean-
-ing); कृष्टधर्मानुयायिनां सिद्धायतनम्।
III A
body of Christians: धर्मः, the c. of Christ :
*कृष्टधर्मः;
the c. of England:
इंलण्डीयधर्मः।

CHURCH (adj.): v. Ecclesiastical. C. -rate :
*धर्ममन्दिरशुल्कः।
C. -warden:
धर्ममन्दिररक्षकः.
C. -yard:
*धर्ममन्दिराङ्गनम्: v. Cemetery.

CHURL:
I A rustic: q. v.
II A boor :
अविनीतः; निर्मर्यादः।

CHURLISH:
I Boorish, rude: q. v.
II U
manageable: q. v.

CHURN (v. t.): मथति
or
मन्थति (मथ्, c. l.)
c. nectar:
मथ्यताममृतम्, V. p.; c. ing of the ocean :
समुद्रमन्थनम्, M. n. C. -staff,; C. -stick:
(1)
मन्थः;
(2) मन्थनः;
(3) मन्थानः;
(4) मन्थदण्ड []
C. ing-rope:
(1) मन्थनरज्जुः;
(2) नेत्रम्, V. p.
